caption: The drawing features a large, ornate, greenish-brown metallic object, shaped like an elongated clock hand, positioned diagonally across the majority of the image, extending from the upper left corner to the lower right corner. The object has a central circular section and both ends are decorated with symmetrical, curving details. In the lower left part of the image, there is a small, sepia-toned architectural drawing of a two-story building with a triangular pediment, columns on the facade, multiple windows, and a cupola on its roof. The background is plain and light, with a faint yellowish border around the edges. The artist's name "IVAR VELIN" and the date "1937" are inscribed below the building.
title: Bishop Hill: Clock Hand
